rows.col_1: GET https://developer.api.autodesk.com/construction/submittals/v2/projects/:projectId/settings/mappings
User context required
data:read
JSON

Must be Bearer <token>, where <token> is a three-legged access token obtained via an Authorization Code flow or a Secure Service Account (SSA) flow.
The SSA flow is designed for headless server-to-server operations. While it functions like a two-legged flow (no user interaction), it is classified as three-legged because it preserves user context.

The ID of the project.
Use the Data Management API to retrieve the project ID. For more information, see the Retrieve a Project ID tutorial. You need to convert the project ID into a project ID for the Forma API by removing the “b." prefix. For example, a project ID of b.a4be0c34a-4ab7 translates to a project ID of a4be0c34a-4ab7.
The maximum number of results per page. Possible values: 1- 50. Default value: 20. For example, to limit the response to two results per page, use limit=2.

The number of results to skip before starting to return data. For example, to skip the first 20 results, include offset=20 in the query string. For more details, see the JSON API Paging Help documentation.
Comma-seperated list of Autodesk IDs for which the mappings will be returned.
Successful retrieval of user-role mappings.
The request could not be understood by the server due to malformed syntax or missing request headers.
Invalid or missing authorization header. Verify the Bearer token and try again.
The user is not authorized to perform this action.
The specified resource was not found.
An unexpected error occurred on the server while processing the request.
Describes pagination details for the response, including information about the current page and navigation to other pages.
The maximum number of results to be displayed on each page.
The number of results skipped before starting the current page.
The overall count of results available across all pages.
The URL to retrieve the preceding page of results, if applicable. Not returned on the first page of results.
The URL to retrieve the subsequent page of results, if available. If not included, this is the last page of data.
A list of user-role mappings defined by administrators.
The unique identifier (UUID) of the user-role mapping record.
The ID for the type of user in the record. Possible values: 1 (user), 2 (company), 3 (role).
Not relevant

The Autodesk ID of the user (autodeskId), role (memberGroupId), or company (memberGroupId).
To find details about users, call GET users, to find details about companies, call GET companies. Note that we do not currently support finding details about roles for a project.
The role of the user in Submittals. Possible values: 1 (manager).
Autodesk ID of the last user who updated the record.
When the record was last updated.
Autodesk ID of the user who has created the project.
When the record was created.
